description: Docs gaps: GET /accounts/{account_id}/workers/durable_objects/namespaces also returns `dispatch_namespace` for namespaces owned by a Workers for Platforms dispatch-namespace script (absent for account-level scripts), and `preview` for a namespace that belongs to a Worker Preview (absent for the script's own namespaces). Without `dispatch_namespace`, a dispatch script's namespaces are indistinguishable from those of an account-level script with the same name. Without `preview`, a Preview's namespace is indistinguishable from its parent script's namespace for the same class: both report the parent's name in `script`. Observed on live listings on 2026-10-09: `{"id": "…", "class": "Counter", "name": "<script>_Counter", "script": "<script>", "use_sqlite": true, "dispatch_namespace": "<namespace>"}`, and on 2026-11-05: `{"id": "…", "class": "Counter", "name": "<script>_<preview>_Counter", "script": "<script>", "use_sqlite": true, "use_containers": true, "preview": {"id": "<preview id>", "slug": "<preview>", "name": "<preview>"}}`.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Workers for Platforms dispatch namespace of the script that owns this namespace; absent for account-level scripts.
The Worker Preview this namespace belongs to; absent for the script's own namespaces. `script` names the Preview's parent Worker.
